title: Seafood Label Extraction Output (v1)
description: Strict output contract for the seafood-label-extraction prompt. The LLM MUST emit exactly one JSON object matching this schema and nothing else (no prose, no markdown fences). This schema is a CONTRACT enforced downstream by the backend LLM-output validation gate (BACKEND-ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.2). Unknown / not-present field values MUST be null and are NEVER fabricated (ADR-0005, constraint #1).

schema_version.description: The contract version this output conforms to. MUST equal the constant below so the backend can route/validate per version.

fields.description: Exactly the closed set of target seafood label fields. Every key is required and present even when its value is null. No keys outside this set are permitted (additionalProperties:false).

raw_warnings.description: TOP-LEVEL label-level anomalies the model observed across the whole label (e.g. conflicting dates, illegible region, two species mentioned, suspected OCR garble). This is observational only and is NEVER a license to infer a field value. May be empty.

confidence.description: Model self-reported confidence in [0.0, 1.0]. 0.0 when value is null. The backend re-derives review bands; this is a hint, never trusted as ground truth.

validation_status.description: Self-classification of the field outcome. Definitions: 'present' = value found and required no normalization; 'normalized' = value found and transformed to the canonical form (date->ISO, F->C, etc.); 'missing' = not present on the label (value MUST be null); 'ambiguous' = present but cannot be resolved to a single confident value (e.g. DD/MM vs MM/DD, two candidate species) - flag, do not guess; 'unnormalizable' = value present and retained verbatim but could not be transformed to the canonical form; 'invalid' = a token was read but it is self-contradictory or fails an obvious sanity check (e.g. negative weight) - retained verbatim with a warning. When value is null, status MUST be 'missing' or 'ambiguous' (ambiguous only when something IS present but unresolvable).

evidence.description: Provenance. The EXACT verbatim substring(s) copied from the supplied OCR text that justify the value. Must be byte-for-byte present in the OCR text (the backend no-fabrication gate, section 8.2.2, rejects evidence not found in the raw OCR). MUST be null if and only if value is null.

envelopeRequired.description: INTERNAL NOTE (not a JSON Schema keyword): every field object has exactly the five keys value, confidence, evidence, validation_status, warnings, with additionalProperties:false. Because JSON Schema draft 2020-12 'additionalProperties' does NOT see properties introduced through 'allOf'/'$ref' composition, each field type below spells out the full property set inline rather than composing an envelope. The cross-field rule 'evidence is null IFF value is null' is NOT expressible in pure JSON Schema and is enforced by the prompt and the backend no-fabrication gate (BACKEND-ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.2.2).

stringField.description: A field whose normalized value is a free-text string (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed) or null.

originCountryField.description: Country of origin / catch. value is an object {raw, iso_3166_1_alpha2} or null. iso_3166_1_alpha2 is populated ONLY when the country is unambiguously determinable from the label text; otherwise null and flagged. The model must NOT invent an ISO code it cannot justify from the text.

faoAreaField.description: FAO major fishing area. value is an object {raw, code} or null. code is the FAO major area number AS WRITTEN ON THE LABEL (e.g. '27', '34'), copied verbatim, never inferred from a place name. If the label only names a sea/ocean with no FAO number, code is null and the field is flagged ambiguous - the model must NOT map a place name to an FAO code.

productionMethodField.description: Constrained vocabulary. value MUST be one of the controlled terms or null. 'wild_caught' / 'farmed' map the two regulated production methods. If the label uses wording that cannot be confidently mapped to exactly one term, value is null, validation_status is 'ambiguous', and a warning records the raw wording. The model must NEVER guess between wild and farmed.

dateField.description: value is an object {iso, original} or null. iso is a full ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) ONLY when the day/month/year are all unambiguous; for a numeric date with ambiguous order (e.g. 04/05/2026 could be 4 May or 5 Apr) iso is null, validation_status is 'ambiguous', and the ambiguity is recorded in warnings. For a partial date (e.g. only month+year, 'best before end 06/2026') iso holds the reduced-precision ISO form (YYYY-MM) and validation_status is 'normalized' with a precision warning. original is the verbatim date string from the label.

temperatureField.description: Storage temperature normalized to Celsius. value is an object or null. kind: 'max' for '<=4C' / 'max 4C', 'min' for '>=-18C', 'range' for '0-4C', 'point' for a single '4C'. celsius_min/celsius_max are numbers in Celsius (for 'max' set celsius_max and leave celsius_min null; for 'min' set celsius_min; for 'point' set both equal; for 'range' set both). If the source unit is Fahrenheit it is converted to Celsius and a conversion warning is added. If the temperature wording cannot be normalized, value is null with validation_status 'unnormalizable' and original retained in a warning.

allergensField.description: value is an array of allergen strings (verbatim as listed, trimmed) or null. Empty list is NOT used to mean 'no allergens stated' - absence of an allergen statement is value null with validation_status 'missing'. A label that explicitly says 'contains: ...' yields the listed items; a label that explicitly states 'allergen-free' or 'none' is recorded as an empty array with validation_status 'present' and a warning noting the explicit none-statement.

weightField.description: Normalized weight. value is an object or null. amount is a number in the unit named by 'unit'. unit policy: weights are expressed in GRAMS ('g') when below 1000 g and KILOGRAMS ('kg') at or above 1 kg, preserving the label's evident magnitude; the chosen unit is stated explicitly in 'unit' so there is no implicit assumption. basis distinguishes net vs gross ('net' | 'gross' | 'unspecified'); if both net and gross appear, prefer net for value and record gross in a warning. drained_weight (number in same unit) or null captures 'drained net weight' if separately present.

priceField.description: Normalized price. value is an object or null. amount is a decimal number. currency is an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code ONLY when the currency is unambiguously determinable (explicit symbol or code on the label); otherwise null and flagged. basis: 'total' for the pack price, 'per_kg' for a unit price per kilogram, 'unspecified' otherwise. If both a total and a per-kg price appear, emit the total as value and record the per-kg figure in a warning (or vice-versa, documented). original is the verbatim price string.
